conclusions.verdict: Accept compile/module provenance with retention limit
conclusions.evidence: Recorded successful strict tsc invocation consumes original TS, writes temporary output, then vm loads files verbatim with substituted vscode/child_process modules. Compiled hashes and actual binary hash recorded; client execution exit0.
conclusions.limit: No production source mutation or fabricated LSP response appears in harness. Temporary compiled files deleted at context exit, so this review cannot reread retained artifacts or independently reproduce hashes; recorded compile receipt is bounded provenance.

conclusions.evidence: Independent decoder verified stdin==sent and stdout==received in all 4 latest sessions (8/5,9/7,5/3,4/3 messages); command stdout/stderr SHA256 and current binary pin match. All child stderrs empty. Real cp.spawn can lsp and CAN_CATALOG inherit recorded environment.
conclusions.limit: Gate/release alters delivery timing but reuses exact bytes emitted by server. It is a controlled latency witness, not untouched pipe scheduling or real host timing.

conclusions.evidence: Real version1 E1006 held while local version2 is sent, then installed. Real version2 empty clears it. Real version3 E1006 held, close clears stand-in collection, then late delivery installs again. No server result invention or version reversal needed.
conclusions.limit: Proves diagnostic collection API writes from actual client at known newer/closed state. Does not demonstrate visible editor Problems UI or that real host would discard/recompute for its own reasons.

conclusions.verdict: Accept version-fence loss, not edit application
conclusions.evidence: Actual version1 rename contains 2 edits; hold reply, mutate document to version2 and call real change handler, release unchanged reply; provider returns edits without document.version check. conclusions.verdict: Accept cancelled hover/provider offer, bound protocol claim

conclusions.verdict: Accept cooperative stop and client-pending death cleanup
conclusions.evidence: Cooperative shutdown/exit reaches code0; collection disposed and calls after stop dropped. SIGTERM real child with response held causes client pending promise null, onExit once, disposed collection, no post-death change.
conclusions.limit: Request was already answered by server; held delivery leaves client pending, so no evidence of interrupting active server analysis. No stubborn child, pipe-only disconnect, rapid overlapping restart or deactivation host deadline certified. One cooperative manual restart separately confirmed by ERC09.

conclusions.verdict: Accept limited host stand-ins, reject full host equivalence
conclusions.evidence: Position validates basic numbers; diagnostic collection tracks writes/delete/dispose; constructors preserve fields; official enum samples independent. Raw server results positive.

Current single URI/set edit witness unaffected, but mixed-edit precedence, URI validation, real UI, actual apply and full VSCode/Cursor compatibility remain unqualified.
